decision.interpretation: Introduces Article 41, marking the start of a new substantive section governing enterprise responsibilities.
Completes the title of Article 41 by specifying the scope 'cyberspace', functioning as part of the article heading.
Introduces Article 42, marking the start of a new substantive section governing agency and individual responsibilities.
Completes the title of Article 42 by specifying the scope 'individuals using cyberspace', functioning as part of the article heading.
